syscalls.comment: Block dangerous syscalls for code execution sandbox (D-08)
Block clone(CLONE_NEWNS = 0x20000). Standard fork and thread creation (no namespace flags) remain allowed for java/node/python.
Block clone(CLONE_NEWNET = 0x40000000). Note: CLONE_NEWCGROUP (0x200000) is not blocked here; the unshare/setns explicit-deny rules above provide defense-in-depth coverage.

_comments._version: 2.1 (clone rules split into 6 SCMP_CMP_EQ to work around Docker 29.x libseccomp bug)
_comments._prior_version: 1.x used single SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ rule on clone with bitmask 0x7C020000
_comments._docker_29_libseccomp_bug: On Docker 29.x + libseccomp 2.6+, ANY SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ rule on clone() matches ALL clones regardless of mask/value semantics (verified 2026-06-12). SCMP_CMP_GE is similarly broken. Only SCMP_CMP_EQ with exact value works. Upgrade monitor: SandboxForkE2EIT.seccompProfile_cloneRulesUseSCMPCMPEQ. If Docker/libseccomp fix is backported, revert to single SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ rule.
_comments._multi_flag_gap: Multi-flag clone (e.g. CLONE_NEWNS|CLONE_NEWPID) is NOT blocked by seccomp -- it falls through to kernel and is denied by CAP_SYS_ADMIN gate from --cap-drop ALL. SandboxServiceImpl.buildDockerCommand() preserves --cap-drop ALL by design; SandboxForkE2EIT.multiFlag_clone_isBlockedByCapabilityGate guards this.
_comments.D-21_syscalls: wait4, times, getrusage -- used by /usr/bin/time for memory tracking. Allowed by SCMP_ACT_ALLOW default.
_comments.D-22_syscalls: openat, write, unlink -- used for stderr temp files (sandbox-stderr-*.log). Allowed by SCMP_ACT_ALLOW default.
_comments.D-15_strategy: SCMP_ACT_ALLOW default with explicit blocks. Does NOT replace Docker's default -- this IS the full profile. Only dangerous syscalls are blocked.
